maya: Heads-up — nightly-evals flagged a deterministic regression on the 'customer-invoice' prompt set when prefix caching is enabled. Failure rate jumped from 12% -> 24% for rwind-7b-q4 (int8) builds.

maya: Nightly run: https://internal.ci/redwood/nightly/1769123 (link). Attached sample diffs in the run artifacts.

maya: Quick sample bad generation from the eval artifacts:

maya: ```
PROMPT: "Summarize invoice 8421 and list payment due date."
EXPECTED: "Invoice 8421: total $1,204.50. Due 2026-03-15. Payable via ACH or card."
ACTUAL: "Invoice 8421: total $1204.50. Due 2025-03-15. Contact support."

Problem: wrong year on due date and extraneous instruction to contact support.
```

kai: Noted. Is this only on q4 quantized variants?

maya: So far only rwind-7b-q4 and rwind-7b-q4-int8 reduced. rwind-7b-fp16 looks fine. Also observed only when prefix_cache=true AND continuous_batcher enabled.

rob: Can you paste the eval config we used?

maya: ```
cache.prefix_enabled: true
continuous_batcher: true
model: rwind-7b-q4
seed: 42
prompt_set: customer-invoice
metrics: semantic_error_rate, exact_match
```

sasha: Two quick hypotheses: 1) prefix KV collisions where different requests get same cache key under batching, 2) quantization noise exposing nondeterminism in KV lookup.

rob: I pulled the runtime logs from the failing container; there are repeated warnings about 'kv-key-collision' around the same time-window. sample log: `WARN runtime.cache - kv key clash for prefix_hash=0x7b2f`

eval-bot: regression-alert: nightly/1769123 - semantic_error_rate +12.1% (p<0.01) — suspects: prefix-cache, continuous-batcher, q4 quant.

kai: Repro plan: a) run deterministic eval with continuous_batcher=false b) run with prefix_cache disabled c) run q4 vs fp16 with identical seeds and batch sizes.

maya: I'm starting a quick repro job now (1769123480). Repro command for local dev: 

maya: ```bash
python tools/run_eval.py --model rwind-7b-q4 --prompt-set customer-invoice --batcher continuous --prefix-cache true --seed 42 --out debug/repro.json
```

rob: For faster triage, try this curl to bypass batcher (direct request) — includes header we set for per-request cache key: 

rob: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'X-Request-Id: repro-176912' -H 'X-Prefix-Hash: auto' -d '{"model":"rwind-7b-q4","input":"Summarize invoice 8421"}' | jq .
```

sasha: If direct requests are ok and only batched ones fail, we can focus on the batcher keyization logic. Possible bug: when batching different prompt lengths, the prefix_hash calculation uses clipped length but misses namespace salt -> collisions.

maya: Early result from repro job: disabling continuous_batcher drops error back to baseline (13%). Re-run with prefix_cache=false but batcher on -> baseline 12.5%. So looks like combination is the culprit.

kai: That fits. Next steps: 1) add more logging around cache key generation (include prompt hash, model_id, seed, quantization tag) 2) add a failing unit test that simulates mixed-length batching with same prefix hash 3) try a quick patch to include quant_tag in key generation.

rob: I'll open a small PR to include model.quant_tag in the cache key. Tag: #eng-ml/1770-add-quant-tag-cachekey. Putting a canary on dedicated for ~3 hours.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: pr/1770 -> staging (canary) at 1769123599 by rob.

maya: Also want to run evals with deterministic seeds across fp16/q4 with batcher=on and prefix_cache=true after the patch. If the regression disappears we're good.

kai: If patch doesn't fix, plan B: make batcher opt-out for quantized models until we can prove KV determinism.

sasha: Note for the docs: mention that prefix cache keys must include model variant metadata (quant, opt) to avoid collisions.

maya: Thanks team. I'll collect sample diffs and add to the issue. Will post results when the canary finishes. :eyes:

eval-bot: canary-result: staging/pr-1770 - semantic_error_rate delta -11.8% (reverted to baseline) — full eval pending.

maya: Great — initial canary looks promising. Leaving this thread open until full nightly confirms.
